description: Grow a Morphogen II field from nothing, here, with the same Gray-Scott rule the page runs (9-point Laplacian, dA 1, dB 0.5, 128x96 cells, wrapping), at a named place or any (F, k), seeded with drops or with a glyph you draw. Returns the field as text at up to four moments you choose, with a count of separate bodies and how much is covered at each, so you can watch it change, and the passage: the last moment folded into the kaleidoscopic tunnel the page flies through, seen from inside. Denser characters mean more of chemical B. Takes a second or two. Nothing is kept unless you then leave a mark.

F.description: Feed rate, 0.004 to 0.09, instead of a place

k.description: Kill rate, 0.036 to 0.072, instead of a place

moments.description: Steps at which to look, default [300, 2000, 7000]

place.description: A named place: spots, mitosis, labyrinth, worms, gliders, spirals, holes, flat, dead

seed.description: Random seed for the drops, for a repeatable run

segments.description: Mirror folds for the passage, default 5, 6 or 8

stamp.description: Seed with a glyph: rows of # and spaces, up to 24 by 24

name: morphogen_grow
title: Grow the field yourself and watch it
